extension.summary: Your FreeX Media Server in Kodi
Dein FreeX Media Server in Kodi
extension.description: Browse the movies and shows of your FreeX Media Server in the design of the FreeX apps and play them with Kodi's own player. Home rows (Continue watching, Up next, Recently added), libraries with filters, collections, playlists, watchlist and search. Kodi plays almost every file directly; watch state and resume positions are kept on the server, so they follow you to FreeX Web and all other FreeX apps. Skip intro and Up Next for episodes.

Durchsuche die Filme und Serien deines FreeX Media Servers im Design der FreeX-Apps und spiele sie mit Kodis eigenem Player ab. Startseiten-Reihen (Weiterschauen, Als Nächstes, Neu hinzugefügt), Bibliotheken mit Filtern, Sammlungen, Playlists, Merkliste und Suche. Kodi spielt fast jede Datei direkt ab; Gesehen-Status und Fortsetzungspunkte liegen auf dem Server und folgen dir zu FreeX Web und allen anderen FreeX-Apps. Intro überspringen und Up Next für Episoden.
extension.news: 1.1.0: - FreeX opens in its own design, the one of FreeX TV and FreeX Web, independent of Kodi's skin: a sidebar with home, watchlist, playlists, search and the libraries; the home rows as rows of rounded cards with progress bars, "unwatched" corners and episode counts; libraries as a grid with filters (all, unwatched, in progress, recently added, collections); detail pages for movies, shows, seasons and episodes with the backdrop, a "Resume S1 E3" button in the brand gradient, buttons for from the start, watched and watchlist, seasons, episodes, extras and cast - Playback started there resumes at the saved position; when it ends, the pages show the new state - "Skip intro" and "Next episode" buttons in the same look - Kodi's lists remain: setting Menu → Open FreeX in its own design
